"""HumanoidBench H1 hurdle driver. Run once per trial; use r.reset() only when budget allows."""
import json, math
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.02
FREQ = 2.0
HIP_SWING = 0.55
KNEE_LIFT = 0.55
ANKLE_SWING = 0.12
STEPS = 50

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
status = r.status()
print("start", json.dumps(status))
if status.get("control_steps", 0) and not status.get("done"):
    reset = r.reset(cameras=["room_camera"], video="frames")
    print("reset", json.dumps(reset.meta))

ranges = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=np.float32)
def norm(q):
    return np.clip(2*(np.asarray(q)-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1, -1, 1)

# Start from the measured bent-knee stance; swing the legs in opposition.
base = np.array([0,0,-0.39,0.80,-0.40, 0,0,-0.39,0.80,-0.40, 0,
                 0.10,0.10,0,0.55, 0.10,-0.10,0,0.55], dtype=float)
actions=[]
for i in range(STEPS):
    t=i*DT
    s=math.sin(2*math.pi*FREQ*t)
    left_forward=max(0,s)
    right_forward=max(0,-s)
    q=base.copy()
    q[2] -= HIP_SWING*s
    q[7] += HIP_SWING*s
    q[3] += KNEE_LIFT*left_forward
    q[8] += KNEE_LIFT*right_forward
    q[4] -= ANKLE_SWING*left_forward
    q[9] -= ANKLE_SWING*right_forward
    q[11] += 0.28*s
    q[15] -= 0.28*s
    actions.append(norm(q))
res=r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(actions,dtype=np.float32), dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
             cameras=["room_camera"], video_fps=10, video="frames", note="short alternating-gait probe")
res.save("/app/output/trial")
print("result", json.dumps(res.meta))
print("final status", json.dumps(r.status()))
